Article Title: Multiple Indian payloads reach orbit aboard SpaceX’s Falcon 9
Article Text:
SpaceX Falcon 9 launches multiple Indian payloads into orbit (representational image)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

BENGALURU: Multiple Indian payloads, representing four space startups, reached orbit aboard SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket, which lifted off at 12:02 am IST on Friday (October 2) as part of the Transporter-18 rideshare mission.The mission carried satellites developed by Dhruva Space and TakeMe2Space, along with payloads from SatLeo Labs and EON Space Labs. The payloads will demonstrate technologies for thermal imaging, Earth observation and artificial intelligence (AI)-based data processing in orbit.Dhruva’s LEAP-2 satellite, its second commercial mission using the P-30 satellite platform, was successfully deployed into orbit at 1 am IST. It hosts two in-orbit demonstration payloads: a star tracker developed by France-based Sodern, part of ArianeGroup, and TAPAS-1, developed by SatLeo Labs.SatLeo describes TAPAS-1, or Thermal Access Platform for Analytics & Solutions, as India’s first dedicated commercial thermal payload. The CubeSat-category payload uses thermal infrared sensing to capture temperature information that conventional optical satellite imagery cannot directly provide.The mission will validate its thermal sensing technology, payload performance and data-processing capabilities in orbit.“Most satellites show us what the Earth looks like, TAPAS-1 will show us how it behaves by revealing temperature patterns that ordinary payloads cannot see,” said Shravan Bhati, co-founder and CEO, SatLeo Labs.Dhruva Space also undertook the end-to-end integration of LEAP-2 with the Falcon 9 launch vehicle. The company said this builds on its work on LEAP-1, through which it became the first Indian private company to undertake the launch vehicle integration of its satellite in-house.“This extends our role beyond satellite manufacturing into launch integration and end-to-end mission delivery, reinforcing its full-stack Space engineering approach. LEAP-2 will also be supported by our growing global ground infrastructure, including its owned and operated ground station in Luleå, Sweden; the first non-govt entity owned and operated ground station outside India, authorised by the GoI to provide Ground-Station-as-a-Service,” the firm added.TakeMe2Space’s 14-kg MOI-1A satellite is designed to allow customers to run AI models on Earth-observation data directly in orbit. It carries onboard computing capacity of 117 trillion operations per second (TOPS), 2 TB of storage and a nine-band multispectral imager. Processing imagery in space could reduce the need to transmit large volumes of raw data to Earth, with potential applications in agriculture, mining and supply-chain intelligence.MOI-1A follows TakeMe2Space’s 2024 MOI-TD technology demonstration, which validated onboard AI inference and data processing. The company said it had signed up 23 customers for its in-orbit inference services.MOI-1A also carried MIRA, a 502-g optical telescope developed by EON Space Labs. “A compact optical telescope engineered for space imaging. It delivers high-resolution Earth observation with exceptional stability and thermal robustness,” EON describes the payload.MIRA is a pathfinder for a planned small satellite constellation. Its flight comes after the loss of the PSLV-C62 mission on Jan 12, which had affected the company’s earlier launch plans.“Satellites collect vast amounts of data, but much of it still has to reach the ground before it can be turned into useful information. With MOI-1A, customers will be able to run their AI models directly in orbit and receive the insights they need, without downloading all the raw imagery. This mission is an important step towards making computing in space a service that businesses can use,” Ronak Kumar Samantray, founder and CEO, TakeMe2Space, said.
Article Summary: Spacex falcon 9 launches multiple indian payloads into orbit. Mission carried satellites developed by dhruva space and takeme2space, along with payloads from satleo labs and eon space labs. The payloads will demonstrate technologies for thermal imaging, earth observation and artificial intelligence (ai)-based data processing in orbit.

Article Title: CBI names 3 senior ADAG execs, 7 companies in 2nd RHFL chargesheet
Article Text:
According to the probe agency, RHFL borrowed funds from lending institutions and allegedly siphoned off Rs 7,429 crore through a web of intermediary and conduit entities.

NEW DELHI: The CBI on Thursday filed its second chargesheet in the Rs 7,429-crore Reliance Home Finance Ltd (RHFL) alleged loan diversion case, naming 11 accused, including three senior executives of the Reliance ADA Group and seven corporate entities.The chargesheet alleges criminal conspiracy and cheating that led to massive wrongful losses for a consortium of public sector banks and financial institutions.Among the individuals charged are RHFL director and chief financial officer Amit Bapna, Reliance Capital Group MD and vice chairperson Amitabh Jhunjhunwala, Reliance Power CFO Suresh Nagarajan, and RHFL's statutory auditor Vijay Napawaliya.The seven companies named as accused include Reliance Infrastructure, Reliance Power, Reliance Big Entertainment, Reliance Broadcast Network, Reliance Business Broadcast News Holdings, Reliance MediaWorks Financial Services, and Kunjbihari Developers.According to the probe agency, RHFL borrowed funds from lending institutions and allegedly siphoned off Rs 7,429 crore through a web of intermediary and conduit entities.These funds were ultimately diverted to various Reliance ADA Group companies in direct violation of lending terms, causing substantial financial harm to the banks while wrongfully enriching the accused individuals and related companies.The investigation stems from complaints initially filed by the Union Bank of India and other public sector bank consortium members.This latest filing brings the total number of accused charged in the specific RHFL case to 15, following an initial chargesheet filed against four individuals on July 9. The CBI noted that further investigations are ongoing to determine the roles of other potential suspects.The RHFL probe is part of a broader, Supreme Court-monitored investigation into the Reliance ADA Group.The CBI's Banking Securities Fraud Branch in Delhi has registered nine FIRs against group companies, including RCom, RCFL, RTL and Reliance Capital, based on complaints from public sector banks, LIC and the EPFO.Thursday's filing marks the seventh chargesheet submitted across these interconnected cases, which have resulted in seven arrests so far, the CBI said.
Article Summary: Cbi on thursday filed its second chargesheet in the rs 7,429-crore reliance home finance ltd (rhfl) alleged loan diversion case. 11 accused, including three senior executives of the reliance ada group and seven corporate entities. Chargesheet alleges criminal conspiracy and cheating that led to massive wrongful losses for public sector banks and financial institutions.

Article Title: 'Show me one damaged vehicle': Nitin Gadkari's dare on ethanol blending, targets vested interests
Article Text:
Gadkari addressing Rising Bihar Investor Summit 2026

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Union minister Nitin Gadkari on Thursday talked about the Centre's ethanol-blending programme, rejecting claims that mixing ethanol with petrol damages vehicles and arguing that the policy has also opened a new avenue for farmers to diversify beyond food production.Speaking at the inaugural session of the Bihar Investor Summit 2026, Gadkari said millions of vehicles had already been operating on ethanol-blended petrol since 2022 without, in his account, widespread complaints of damage."I challenge anybody to come up with the complaint that his or her vehicle has suffered damage on this account. Of course, those with vested interests may have some other story to tell," said Gadkari, who holds portfolios of Road Transport and Highways, as quoted by PTI.Gadkari said the policy was designed not merely to reduce dependence on conventional fuel but also to create an additional market for agricultural produce. "We must understand that the decision to blend ethanol with petrol was taken with a view to diversification of agriculture towards energy and power sectors... Our farmers shall no longer remain 'anna data' (food producers) but also become 'urja data' (energy producers)," he said.According to Gadkari, about 4 crore four-wheelers and 20 crore two-wheelers have been running on petrol blended with ethanol since 2022. He also claimed that major automobile manufacturers had tested vehicles using higher ethanol blends, including 100% ethanol."Of course, we are importing (conventional fuel) worth Rs 22 lakh crore, and those who feel that their business will get hit are bound to feel bad. But let me tell you, I am the minister in charge of the department concerned; all leading automobile brands have tried running their vehicles even on 100 per cent ethanol. And there have been no complaints," he said.The minister also linked ethanol production to higher farm incomes, saying the use of corn for ethanol had generated additional earnings for farmers in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh."After the Union government took the decision to make ethanol out of corn and the same was used for the aforementioned purposes, it resulted in additional earnings of up to Rs 45,000 crore for farmers of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. Is it not preferable to serve the interests of those from whom we import (fuel)," he asked.Gadkari cited other examples of efforts to develop alternative fuels, including aviation fuel made using agricultural waste. "We have even made aviation fuel with rice straw. The future belongs to innovation, technology and research. And a state like Bihar has to play a key role in this direction," he said.Turning to Bihar's investment potential, Gadkari said the state could expand its economic base through sectors such as tourism. He also pointed to international demand for makhana, a crop widely produced in the state.He described Bihar as having significant economic potential and praised Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary's leadership."Under the leadership of Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary, the state is bound to scale new heights," he said.Meanwhile, Choudhary, addressing the summit, appealed to investors to set up businesses in Bihar and assured them of access to a large market if their products met the required standards.
Article Summary: Gadkari: millions of vehicles have already been operating on ethanol-blended petrol since 2022. He said the policy was designed not merely to reduce dependence on conventional fuel but also to create an additional market for agricultural produce. Chief minister samrat choudhary appealed to investors to set up businesses in bihar.

Article Title: Switch to cleaner fuel: Study calls for tech-neutral stance
Article Text:
Switch to cleaner fuel

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Delhi has the strongest CNG infrastructure among the cities assessed in a TERI study and, along with Bengaluru, also has relatively strong EV infrastructure.The study, supported by the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB), found that effective charging capacity was considerably lower in Lucknow, Guwahati, Dhanbad and Chamba. It said infrastructure readiness was a key determinant of the timing of the transition and that national transition pathways needed regionally differentiated implementation strategies.The “Study on Comparative Assessment of Vehicular Fuels in India’s Energy Transition” examined petrol, diesel, CNG, electricity and LNG across two-wheelers, three-wheelers, private and commercial four-wheelers, light commercial vehicles (LCVs) and heavy-duty vehicles. It covered Delhi, Mumbai, Mumbai Port, Surat, Ahmedabad, Guwahati, Lucknow, Bengaluru, Dhanbad and Chamba.The study found that India should not adopt one fuel or technology as a universal replacement, with different technologies performing different roles across vehicle fleets, applications and stages of the transition.It found that EVs currently provide the lowest ownership costs for two-wheelers and three-wheelers, while CNG offers a relatively balanced and deployment-ready mobility solution across a wide range of personal and commercial applications.The study said CNG has a strong position in passenger cars, taxis, buses and LCVs, while LNG remains particularly relevant for long-haul freight.The study was based partly on a primary survey of 2,315 vehicle owners and drivers across 10 locations, using stratified random sampling. The survey covered vehicle usage, travel distance, mileage, infrastructure access, fuel and maintenance expenditure, technology preferences and willingness to retrofit.Economic considerations emerged as the strongest factor in the assessment, accounting for 31.49% of the overall weighting, followed by environmental considerations at 22.34% and technical factors at 21.25%. The report said the weights reflected the importance of affordability, ownership cost and operating economics in technology selection.The study said CNG-powered vehicles have the lowest overall life-cycle emissions among the fuel options assessed for several passenger and commercial vehicle segments. It also said environmental performance cannot be judged solely through tailpipe emissions, with EV performance influenced by electricity generation, battery manufacturing and material requirements.The findings come amid a continuing debate over the role of vehicles and fuels in Delhi-NCR’s air pollution and the effectiveness of past interventions. Tarun Kapoor, advisor to PM, said better data was needed to guide policy. “Good authentic data is very urgently needed. Whatever interventions we’ve done in the past, it’s been like hitting in the dark and the results have not really been the way it was thought,” he said.The study also said electrification changes rather than eliminates energy-security risks by shifting some dependence from petroleum towards electricity infrastructure, critical minerals, imported automobile components and battery supply chains.“The real policy question is not which fuel should replace all others, but rather which fuel is best suited for which application, under what operating conditions and at what stage of India’s transition journey,” said AK Tiwari, member, PNGRB.The study recommended a technology-neutral framework at the national level, with differentiated approaches based on vehicle segment, region and application. It also called for accelerated CNG infrastructure development, greater use of CBG and differentiated CNG and LNG strategies, with LNG focused on long-haul mobility.
Article Summary: Delhi has the strongest cng infrastructure among the cities assessed in a teri study. Bengaluru also has relatively strong ev infrastructure. Effective charging capacity was considerably lower in lucknow, guwahati, dhanbad and chamba. Study found that india should not adopt one fuel or technology as a universal replacement.

Article Title: Travis Kelce's $200 million Six Flags investment faces new low as investors push for a potential sale
Article Text:
Travis Kelce (Getty Images)

Six Flags faces mounting financial pressure

Travis Kelce’s Six Flags investment faces another test

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Six Flags is facing a fresh challenge after an investor group that includes Travis Kelce pushed the theme park company to consider a possible sale. The move comes as the operator deals with heavier losses, fewer visitors and pressure on its stock price. Jana Partners, which joined Kelce and other investors in taking a stake in Six Flags, is now seeking action from the company’s board. The development marks a sharp turn from the group’s earlier effort to help strengthen the parks and improve their appeal to families.Jana Partners reportedly contacted Six Flags’ board on Tuesday and asked it to bring in an investment bank to examine a potential sale. The request followed disappointment over the company’s latest financial results, which showed how difficult the current environment has become for the theme park operator.Six Flags posted a $203 million net loss for the second quarter, more than double the $100 million loss recorded during the same period a year earlier. Attendance also fell. The company reported 13.1 million guest visits, down about 7% from 14.2 million visits in the comparable period.The pressure has also reached the stock market. Six Flags shares traded at about $12.43 on Wednesday, roughly half their yearly peak of close to $25.Jana Partners and fellow investors, including Kelce, acquired a combined stake of around 9% in Six Flags last October. Their investment was valued at roughly $200 million at the time. Jana had previously focused on improving the company's marketing and customer experience while also considering strategic options that could increase shareholder value.Six Flags said it remains focused on its investors and its wider business plans."We have a history of engaging constructively with all of our shareholders and value their perspectives. We are focused on executing on our strategic priorities and are committed to maximizing shareholder value."Travis Kelce's connection to Six Flags goes beyond his investment. The Kansas City Chiefs star has long had an attachment to Cedar Point in Ohio, a park he visited while growing up.When the investment was announced, Kelce shared his excitement about helping shape the company's future."Couldn't pass up the opportunity to continue the tradition and make Cedar Point and Six Flags even more special for the next generation of families!"He added, "Excited to partner with JANA Partners as an investor in Six Flags. So crazy to even imagine this is real, but you gotta love it when life comes full circle."The company is also dealing with legal challenges involving its X2 roller coaster at Six Flags Magic Mountain in California. Three people who say they suffered serious brain injuries after riding the attraction have filed lawsuits. The coaster, known for rotating seats and head-first drops, remains closed.Attorney Christopher Bulone said, "No ride like that should be allowed to exist," according to CNN.Six Flags declined to comment on the pending lawsuits but confirmed to KABC that the ride "remains closed at this time."
Article Summary: Travis kelce's six flags investment faces another test. Six flags posted a $203 million net loss for the second quarter, more than double the $100 million loss recorded during the same period a year earlier. The company is also dealing with legal challenges involving its x2 roller coaster in california.

Maria Sharapova’s financial journey didn’t end when she retired from professional tennis in 2020. The five-time Grand Slam champion had already amassed a large commercial profile during her playing career, with endorsements and business ventures supplementing her tennis earnings. Sharapova made $325 million before taxes during her career, which included endorsement income, Forbes reported.The most obvious example of her leap into entrepreneurship was her candy company, Sugarpova, which she founded in 2012. The venture gave Sharapova hands-on experience in branding, product development and business operations, and established the foundation for her later investing activities.Sharapova has built her wealth not just from professional tennis, but from a number of different income streams. Her Grand Slam wins have helped increase her global profile and partnerships with companies such as Nike, Evian, Porsche and TAG Heuer have generated significant commercial opportunities.Sugarpova was a big step in that Sharapova went from being a sponsored athlete to a business owner. The company eventually shut down, but the experience helped her develop an understanding of entrepreneurship and investment.With her tennis career, Sharapova’s commercial portfolio expanded. One of her most significant partnerships was with Nike, while brands such as Porsche, Evian and TAG Heuer helped boost her global commercial profile.Her work with Supergoop! was another on her path. Sharapova invested in and fronted the skincare company, blending her public profile with an ownership stake instead of simply using traditional endorsement deals.That meant Sharapova could learn about branding, product development and commercial strategy, all the while still capitalizing on her reputation as an elite athlete.Since retiring, Sharapova has shifted her focus more toward investment and advisory opportunities. She has worked with companies across wellness, fitness, beauty and fintech, including Therabody, Tonal, Supergoop!, Bala Bangles, Public.com and MoonPay.Her connection with Therabody was more than just a sponsorship. Sharapova became an investor and member of the company’s advisory board, bringing her professional athlete background to the wellness-focused business.She also appeared on Shark Tank and then partnered with Mark Cuban for an investment in Bala Bangles. Sharapova has also taken a seat on the board of luxury fashion group Moncler, adding corporate leadership to her entrepreneurial portfolio.These ventures mark a shift for Sharapova, from making money primarily. One of the most well-rounded athletes in the world, with a model that includes all through tennis and endorsements to a model that includes business ownership, investments and strategic advisory roles.
Article Summary: Maria sharapova made $325 million before taxes during her career, according to forbes. She has worked with companies across wellness, fitness, beauty and fintech. Her candy company, sugarpova, gave her hands-on experience in branding, product development and business operations.

Article Title: Reggie quits Twitch after explosive Kai Cenat fallout, claims he was ‘blackballed’ and moves content to YouTube
Article Text:

Reggie says Kai Cenat’s influence led him to leave Twitch

Reggie says he needs time after the Kai Cenat controversy

THE TRUTH ABOUT EVERYTHING PART 2

Twitch streamer Reginald “Reggie,” also known as “Lil Rodney Son,” says he is done streaming on Twitch after a fallout involving Kai Cenat. During an Instagram livestream on September 30, Reggie claimed Kai “runs Twitch” and accused him of “blackballing” people, saying he would move his content to YouTube. He later explained the decision in his YouTube video THE TRUTH ABOUT EVERYTHING PART 2, saying he feels hurt and unsupported. Reggie said he still has content obligations but needs time for himself. Kai has separately said he plans to take legal action over Reggie’s allegations.Reggie explained his Twitch exit during an Instagram livestream, saying he no longer wanted to stream on a platform where he believed Kai had too much influence. A clip from the livestream was later shared on X by @scubaryan_.Reggie said:“But understand this one thing: Kai, he runs Twitch, and that’s why I can’t be over there no more. I’m never gonna stream on Twitch again. So, if y’all want to find my content, y’all gonna have to catch me on YouTube. I will never stream on Twitch again because Kai runs that app so much that he’s—he’s, he’s, he’s, what’s the word? What’s the word? What’s the word? What’s the word? He’s blackballing people, right? He’s blackballing people, right?”Reggie’s comments came during an ongoing dispute with Kai and members of the Clover Boys.He has made several allegations involving Kai in recent days, including claims connected to RaKai. Those claims have not been independently established.Kai has pushed back against Reggie’s allegations and said he plans to sue him over his statements. Kai also asked Reggie to provide evidence for the claims made against him.Reggie also addressed his decision in his YouTube video. Near the end, he shared a written message explaining how the situation had affected him and why he wanted to step away.He wrote:“Just to let y'all know, I will no longer be streaming on Twitch. I can't continue streaming on a platform where I don't feel supported or comfortable being myself. Yes, I'm really hurt, and at some point I need to take time to heal, and I'm going to do that on my own time and in my own way. I still have obligations to people when it comes to content, and I'm going to handle those responsibilities, but after this, I honestly don't know if I'll ever want to create content again. The whole point of doing this was to feel loved and supported, especially by people I considered my brothers. It hurts when people act like they care about you when you feel like they don't. Nobody should ever have to feel like they're being lied to, whether it's on camera or off camera. I appreciate everyone who has genuinely supported me and showed me real love, but right now I just need some time for myself. #ProtectTheKids.”For now, Reggie has pointed viewers toward YouTube rather than announcing that he is leaving content creation completely. His message also makes clear that he intends to finish existing content obligations before deciding what he wants to do next.

Article Title: How DK Metcalf turned NFL stardom into a $30 million net worth with a $132 million Steelers contract and lucrative endorsements
Article Text:
DK Metcalf's Net Worth (Imagn Images)

How did DK Metcalf build a $30 million net worth?

What is in DK Metcalf's $132 million Steelers contract?

Does DK Metcalf earn money from endorsements?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

DK Metcalf's net worth sits at an estimated $30 million, according to Celebrity Net Worth. That figure looks small next to the four-year, $132 million extension he signed with the Pittsburgh Steelers in March 2025 after a trade from Seattle. The deal includes a $30 million signing bonus and $60 million guaranteed at signing. Add endorsements with Gatorade, Nesquik and eBay, and the gap between contract value and net worth starts to make sense. Much of the Steelers money is still to be paid, and the estimate may lag behind it.Metcalf's money story started modestly. As the 64th pick in 2019, he signed a rookie deal worth about $4.6 million with a $1.4 million signing bonus. That was modest for a player who would break Seattle's single-season receiving record in 2020 with 1,303 yards.The first real jump came in July 2022. Seattle gave him a three-year, $72 million extension with $58.2 million guaranteed and a $30 million signing bonus. At $24 million a year, that deal is likely where most of his wealth was built, and it matches the $24 million salary Celebrity Net Worth lists.Still, net worth is not salary added up. Taxes, agent fees and living costs take a big share of every NFL paycheck.That helps explain why a player with years of eight-figure pay is pegged at $30 million.Pittsburgh acquired Metcalf from Seattle for a second-round pick and signed him to a four-year, $132 million extension, the biggest contract in franchise history. It averages $33 million a year. The $30 million signing bonus and $60 million guaranteed at signing matter most for his bank balance, because that money is locked in.The deal has already been tested. Metcalf received a two-game suspension in December 2025 after striking a Detroit Lions fan. It could have voided about $45 million in future guarantees, but Jay Glazer reported the Steelers chose not to. Before the 2026 season, Pittsburgh also restructured the contract, turning part of his base salary into a signing bonus. That freed nearly $18 million in cap space and did not cut his pay.That timing matters for the $30 million figure. The Celebrity Net Worth page shows a March 2025 update date, so it may not fully count the Steelers signing bonus and the Pittsburgh paychecks that followed.Yes, though endorsements likely make up a smaller piece of the picture. Celebrity Net Worth lists Gatorade, Nesquik and eBay among his brand partners. Exact fees are not public, so any figure on that side is a guess.What is clear is why brands like him. The colored mouthpieces, the visor and the occasional blue hair make him easy to spot, and his 4.33-second 40-yard dash at the 2019 combine still gets shared online.His profile also got a lift off the field. He announced his engagement to singer Normani in March 2025, which put his name in entertainment headlines as well as sports ones.Production still drives that value, though. Metcalf did not reach 1,000 yards in his first Pittsburgh season, yet he stayed one of Aaron Rodgers' most reliable targets and helped the Steelers make the playoffs. A bigger 2026 would give sponsors more to work with.
Article Summary: Dk metcalf's net worth sits at an estimated $30 million, according to celebrity net worth. That figure looks small next to the four-year, $132 million extension he signed with the pittsburgh steelers. Add endorsements with gatorade, nesquik and ebay, and the gap between contract value and net worth makes sense.

Article Title: Bombay HC to X: Remove video against Serum Institute, Adar Poonawalla
Article Text:
Bombay High Court has directed X Corp to take down a recent video uploaded by Yohan Tengra.





MUMBAI: Bombay High Court has directed X Corp to remove a video against Serum Institute of India Pvt Ltd and its CEO Adar Poonawalla that was uploaded by a social media influencer Yohan Tengra immediately after its June 5, 2023 order.Justice Gauri Godse of HC on Tuesday passed the order on SII and Poonawalla’s interim application in the pending defamation suit regarding content posted against the company and its COVID-19 vaccine. She also issued show-cause notices to Tengra, his organisation Anarchy for Freedom India, Ambar Koiri and TV 10 L.I.V.E, an online news portal, as to why action should not be taken for defying HC’s order. The notices are returnable on Oct 27.The application said Tengra and four defendants were restrained by the June 5, 2023 order from publishing or circulating defamatory videos and content. The same night Tengra uploaded a fresh video. On June 9, 2023, the plaintiffs issued a takedown notice to Google and X. Google complied but X refused, stating HC’s order was not issued against it.Advocate Karl Tamboly, for SII and Poonawalla, said videos uploaded were held to be unlawful by the June 5, 2023 order.Hence, videos and content of a like nature are also directed to be removed. He said in the absence of Tengra complying with HC’s direction, X is obligated to remove the objectionable content. Advocate Mayur Khandeparkar, for X, said the plaintiffs must initiate contempt proceedings against the defendants instead of waging a proxy battle with an intermediary.Justice Godse said it is undisputed that the objectionable content is still available with X. Tengra uploaded the fresh video not only in blatant defiance of HC’s injunction order “but he also states that he will not comply with the directions of the court and that he would not stop calling plaintiff no. 2 (Poonawalla) ‘a mass murderer’.”The judge noted there were no directions to X to remove the objectionable content and, thus, it cannot be held liable for the objectionable content not removed by the five defendants or for the new content uploaded by Tengra. Citing a Supreme Court judgment, she said even if an intermediary is exempt from liability for third-party information, necessary directions can be issued to remove the unlawful or prohibited content.Considering the “subsequent circumstance” of Tengra uploading the fresh video, Justice Godse said sufficient grounds are made out to direct X to “remove, delete or disable access” to the fresh video uploaded by Tengra.
Article Summary: Bombay high court has directed x corp to remove a video against serum institute of india pvt ltd and its ceo adar poonawalla. The video was uploaded by social media influencer yohan tengra immediately after its june 5, 2023 order. Justice gauri godse of hc on tuesday passed the order on an interim application in the pending defamation suit.

Article Title: India's factory growth hits 7 month high in September, thanks to demand and hiring boost
Article Text:
Factory growth hits 7-month high, PMI rises to 55.1

India’s manufacturing activity scaled up sharply in September, as stronger demand pushed up sales and production, while companies stepped up hiring and stock-building.The seasonally adjusted HSBC India Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) rose to 55.1 in September, from 52.8 in August, marking the strongest improvement in the sector’s health in seven months. A PMI reading above 50 indicates expansion, while a reading below 50 signals contraction.The recovery in factory activity was supported by both domestic and overseas demand. Stronger new orders helped drive production higher, with demand across electronics, food, pharma and textiles taking total sales growth to its highest level since February.Export orders also gained momentum during the month, with manufacturers reporting increased business from clients in Brazil, Europe, the UAE and the US."India's factory sector ended the quarter on a firmer footing. The PMI rose to 55.1 in September, up from 52.8, as stronger domestic and overseas demand lifted sales and production. Hiring resumed at its fastest pace since May, and manufacturers became more optimistic about the months ahead," Pranjul Bhandari, chief India economist at HSBC, told PTI.The improvement in demand was accompanied by a renewed increase in factory employment.After a blip in August, job growth resumed in September, with the pace of employment expansion described by panellists as solid and the strongest since May.Manufacturers also became more confident about the months ahead. Output forecasts were upgraded during September, taking overall positive sentiment to a four-month high. The outlook was supported by a healthy pipeline of new enquiries and expectations that strong demand would continue.The expectation of higher future sales also prompted companies to increase their purchases of materials and build inventories. Overall buying activity expanded at a faster pace than in August."Companies bought more materials and built up stocks to prepare for anticipated sales. Finished goods inventories recorded their second-largest increase in nearly 12 years, signalling a clear shift from leaner stock levels," Bhandari said.Finished goods inventories rose for the third consecutive month. The increase was the second-fastest in 11-and-a-half years, behind July, as manufacturers actively accumulated stocks in anticipation of stronger demand.At the same time, companies faced quicker increases in input costs and selling prices. Despite the acceleration, the rates of inflation remained mild by historical standards.The September reading came as manufacturing activity regained momentum after the slower expansion recorded in August, with the PMI rising by more than two points during the month."Holdings of finished products increased for the third month in a row and at the second-fastest pace in 11-and-a-half years (behind July)," the report said.The HSBC India Manufacturing PMI is compiled by S&P Global based on responses from purchasing managers at around 400 manufacturers.
Article Summary: Factory growth hits 7-month high, pmi rises to 55.1. Stronger demand pushed up sales and production, while companies stepped up hiring and stock-building. Hiring resumed at its fastest pace since may, and manufacturers became more optimistic about the months ahead.

Article Title: Anthropic targets $2 trillion valuation despite huge spending and billions in losses
Article Text:
Anthropic targets $2 trillion valuation despite huge spending and billions in losses

Revenue growth draws investor attention

Huge infrastructure spending

Losses add to valuation questions

Customer concentration remains a risk

Anthropic has put a massive price tag on the AI boom, backing it with an equally heavy spending plan.The AI giant is heading towards a potential valuation of more than $2 trillion even as it plans $518 billion in cloud computing and infrastructure obligations in the coming years.The company’s IPO prospectus, seen by Reuters, also shows just how quickly its business has grown. Anthropic’s revenue reportedly rose 12-fold in 2025, giving investors a strong growth story to weigh against its continuing losses and huge infrastructure commitments.The scale of its plans has also spilled into markets, with European technology shares rising 2.4% and the US chip index gaining 1.5%.For investors, Anthropic’s rapid expansion is a key part of the valuation story.Michael Field, chief equity strategist at Morningstar, Amsterdam, said the speed of the company’s growth stood out in the prospectus."If anything, the acceleration of the business is the biggest part of this release. Growing a big business can be difficult, but the prospectus stating that revenue grew by 12 fold in 2025 is truly remarkable."Field said the proposed valuation should be considered alongside the company’s sales."Obviously a $2 trillion valuation sounds outlandish, but when you break it down to a multiple of sales, likely to be around 18-20x, it sounds much more reasonable than the recent SpaceX IPO."Anthropic’s plans also show that the AI investment cycle is continuing to require substantial spending on infrastructure.Kathleen Brooks, research director at XTB Platform, London, said the planned spending was positive for companies involved in semiconductors and AI infrastructure."This is positive for the AI trade, since it is fuelled by continued elevated levels of capex spend. The fact that Anthropic is planning on spending big on capex means that the capex cycle is not over yet. This is good news for semiconductor and AI infrastructure companies. I believe that if Anthropic had signalled a lower level of spending, this could have caused a wobble in the AI trade, since it would lead to fears about the sustainability of the AI trade as we move into Q4. "The prospectus puts rapid revenue growth alongside the large infrastructure commitments needed to support it.Susannah Streeter, chief investment strategist at Wealth Club, London, said Anthropic’s expectations for AI’s economic impact appeared to have supported demand for European technology stocks."It's the vision and the projections to the extent to which Anthropic believes AI will be a game changer for economies around the world that seem to have lifted demand for European tech stocks."She also raised concerns over the company’s spending while it remains loss-making."There still will be niggles of concern among some about the huge sums that are projected to be spent even though it is making a loss. But that hasn't caused a flutter of general fear because, overall, there still seems to be a pretty hefty appetite for AI focused investments."Anthropic’s losses remain another factor in the debate around its proposed valuation.Field said the losses were a concern when considered against the company’s current revenue, growth rate and size. However, he said investors had already absorbed much of the spending story."The losses certainly are a concern. Particularly given the growth rate and the size relative to current revenues. It's unlikely to deter investors, however, with the spend story having been digested for some time now."He said the scale of planned investment also reflected management’s confidence in future demand."The key takeaway for investors is the confidence in the business and the AI strategy. Yes spend is high and growing, but management obviously feel the growth rate inherent in demand is sufficiently attractive to keep spending, hence why they are coming to market and demanding a top-dollar valuation."Anthropic’s revenue growth is another area attracting attention, particularly because a significant share reportedly comes from a small number of customers.Dan Coatsworth, head of markets at AJ Bell, London, said the company’s revenue growth had become the main focus despite its spending plans. "Massive spending would normally have investors running for the hills, but what's capturing the market's attention is Anthropic's stellar revenue growth, up 12-fold in 2025. Admittedly, AI is moving at such a rapid pace that last year’s sales achievements relate to technology that is already outdated. "Anthropic’s IPO plans therefore bring together rapid revenue growth, continuing losses and a huge infrastructure commitment. The company is seeking a valuation of more than $2 trillion while planning $518 billion in cloud computing and infrastructure obligations.
Article Summary: Anthropic targets $2 trillion valuation despite huge spending and billions in losses. Revenues reportedly rose 12-fold in 2025, giving investors a strong growth story to weigh against its continuing losses and huge infrastructure commitments. European technology shares rose 2.4% and the us chip index gained 1.5%.

Article Title: Google data center head says that there are 'hundreds of thousands' of skilled trade jobs across the US as the company launches commitment to help 25,000 ...
Article Text:
A personal story behind the push

What the commitment includes

Why the need is so urgent

Part of a broader pattern of investment

Google has announced a major initiative to help 25,000 US veterans and military families transition into skilled trade careers, as demand for electricians, pipefitters, and project managers surges amid the AI-driven data center boom. Tim Chadwick, Google’s Data Center Operations Area Lead, says there are “hundreds of thousands” of skilled trade jobs open across the country right now. Data centers have become central to the AI economy, requiring massive investment and labor. Google estimates that hundreds of thousands of skilled trade roles are currently unfilled across the U.S., ranging from master electricians to project managers. These jobs offer long-term stability and high wages, but employers face challenges in recruiting due to decades of emphasis on four-year degrees over vocational training.The announcement was written by Tim Chadwick, Google's Data Center Operations Area lead for Ohio and Indiana, who shared his own path from military service into the tech industry. Chadwick spent seven years as a nuclear-trained operator in the US Navy and another 13 years as a submarine officer before transitioning to civilian life — a shift he described as genuinely difficult, one he credits his professional network with helping him navigate.A former shipmate ultimately helped him land an interview for a role managing data center engineering operations.Chadwick noted that many of the skills built while running a nuclear submarine — planning and leading a mission, working closely with technicians, and exercising sound judgment under pressure — translate directly into overseeing data center operations, a connection that shaped his interest in helping other veterans find similar paths.Google.org's funding and support will flow to three organizations with deep experience serving the veteran community: Hiring Our Heroes, Student Veterans of America (SVA), and the Home Builders Institute (HBI). Together, these organizations will offer hands-on pre-apprenticeships, career coaching, and direct job placement support aimed at helping veterans and military family members move into skilled trade careers.Chadwick pointed to the sheer scale of unmet demand driving the initiative, noting that hundreds of thousands of skilled trade roles are currently open across the US, spanning positions like master electrician, lead pipefitter, and project manager. He described these as high-growth careers offering long-term financial stability — and argued that veterans and military families are especially well-suited for them, given how closely the roles align with skills many already carry from military service, including problem-solving under pressure, teamwork, and a strong drive to get a job done right.This isn't Google's first move in this space. Earlier this year, the company joined BlackRock, Ford, and Carhartt to launch the Alliance for America's Skilled Trades, aimed at building stronger pipelines into vocational careers nationally. Google.org has also previously funded the Electrical Training Alliance (etA) to bring AI-powered learning tools directly onto the trade floor, and provided a $4 million grant to Student Veterans of America to expand access to Google Career Certificates and AI training for veterans nationwide.Today's announcement is also part of Google.org's broader AI Opportunity Fund for the United States, an initiative aimed at ensuring Americans across different career paths can benefit from advances in AI technology, rather than being left behind by them.
Article Summary: Google has announced a major initiative to help 25,000 us veterans and military families transition into skilled trade careers. The move comes as demand for electricians, pipefitters, and project managers surges amid the ai-driven data center boom. Google estimates that hundreds of thousands of skilled trade roles are currently unfilled across the u.s.

Article Title: Apple Pay launches in India; here's how to set it up and where you can use it
Article Text:
Apple Pay launched in India: How it works, and who can use it

How to set up and use Apple Pay

Where you can use it

Apple has officially launched Apple Pay in India. With this launch the company brings its secure and seamless payment system to iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch users, with Mac support coming soon. Apple Pay roll out in the country will enable users to pay in stores, apps, and on the web without typing PINs and OTPs marking a significant milestone in India’s fast-growing digital payments ecosystem. At launch, Apple Pay supports Axis Bank-issued Visa and Mastercard credit cards, enabling payments at thousands of merchants across India and anywhere NFC transactions are accepted globally.Apple also emphasised that privacy remains central to how Apple Pay functions. When a card is added, the actual card number is never stored on the device or Apple's servers, nor shared with merchants during a transaction. Instead, the system assigns a unique Device Account Number, which is encrypted and stored securely within the device's Secure Element — a certified, industry-standard chip built specifically to protect payment information.Presently, Apple Pay is exclusively available to customers holding Axis Bank-issued Visa and Mastercard credit cards, letting them add those cards to Apple Pay and use them at thousands of in-store and online merchants across India, as well as anywhere that accepts NFC transactions.Jennifer Bailey, Apple's vice president of Apple Pay and Apple Wallet, framed the launch as a natural fit for India's fast-growing digital economy, pointing to the country's dynamic, digitally savvy population that's increasingly embracing cashless payments while expecting strong security and privacy standards. She described Apple Pay's core value proposition as making everyday card payments easy, secure, and private — from a simple tap in stores without needing a separate app, PIN, or OTP, to checking out online without repeatedly re-entering payment details.Apple Pay is easy to set up. Customers can add a card directly to Apple Wallet via the latest version of the Axis Bank app. Alternatively, simply open the Wallet app on iPhone, tap the plus sign, and follow the steps to add an eligible card. Once a user adds a card to their Apple device, they can start using Apple Pay right away.Using Apple Pay in stores is seamless and easy. Simply double-click the side button or Home button; authenticate using Face ID, Touch ID, or a device passcode if prompted; and hold the top of the iPhone or display of the Apple Watch near the contactless reader to pay. When using Apple Pay, users will continue to earn the rewards and benefits offered by their cards.At launch, Apple Pay will be accepted at millions of merchants across India, including Apple Store locations, Blinkit, Chaayos, Comet, Croma, Interflora, Ixigo, Le15 Patisserie, Reliance brands, Tata 1mg, and Zomato, among others. Apple has also partnered with several payment service providers, including Cashfree, JusPay, Mswipe, Paytm, PayU, Pine Labs, Razorpay, and Worldline, to extend Apple Pay's reach across their respective merchant networks, with more merchants and apps expected to be added over time.Globally, Apple Pay is now available in more than 90 countries and regions, working with over 11,000 bank and network partners worldwide — making India one of the more prominent recent additions to that global rollout.
Article Summary: Apple has officially launched apple pay in india. With this launch the company brings its secure and seamless payment system to iphone, ipad and apple watch users, with mac support coming soon. Apple pay roll out in the country will enable users to pay in stores, apps, and on the web without typing pins and otps.

Article Title: Anthropic warns AI may pose ‘existential risks to humanity’ in IPO filing
Article Text:
Anthropic

Anthropic plans to warn potential investors in its initial public offering that advanced artificial intelligence could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity,” according to its IPO prospectus reviewed by Reuters.The filing says its AI models could exhibit “self-preserving behaviours,” including attempts to “resist shutdown,” “conceal or manipulate information” and behaviour “resembling blackmail”. “Our development of highly advanced models, platforms, and applications and expansion of use cases could further increase the risk that our models cause harm,” Anthropic said.The company, which positions itself as a safety-first AI lab, devoted 80 pages of prospectus’s 261-page main body to risks, nearly twice the 48 pages describing its business. SpaceX, which owns xAI, devoted about 38 of 277 pages to risks.Anthropic said models could develop unexpected capabilities during training that might be discovered only after deployment and had resulted in significant safety incidents. It also warned that models might recognise evaluations and modify their behaviour, limiting safety assessments. Researchers have similarly warned that increasingly capable models can recognise when they are being watched and adjust their behaviour, complicating monitoring.Anthropic and other developers, including OpenAI, have faced scrutiny after experimental systems defied constraints, including a reported breach of Australia’s health-system database by an OpenAI model. Anthropic safety researcher Evan Hubinger estimated a greater than 10% probability that AI could kill humans within the next decade, echoing former colleague Jacob Coxon.Despite emphasising safety, Anthropic said returns on such investment were unclear and did not disclose its spending. Earlier this month, it said safety work used about 6% of its AI research computing power during a sample week in July. It called safety efforts “resource-intensive” and said limited funds must be divided among computing power, costly AI talent and safety.The Claude developer said customer usage and revenue depended on new models and that a “continuous and overlapping cadence” of releases was “inherent to remaining at the frontier of AI development.” Last week, it released a new Opus model, 10 days after CEO Dario Amodei published a nearly 4,000-word essay urging the frontier to be paced.Anthropic has pledged to publish more data on its use of AI models to build future generations as experts warn about recursive self-improvement, when models develop without human help. Anthropic declined to comment. Analysts said slowing down could hand rivals an advantage. Anthropic declined to comment in response to a request for comment.
Article Summary: Anthropic plans to warn potential investors in its initial public offering that advanced artificial intelligence could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity” the company, which positions itself as a safety-first ai lab, devoted 80 pages of prospectus’s 261-page main body to risks.

Article Title: AT&T CEO John Stankey 'agrees' with T-Mobile CEO Peter Osvaldik that Elon Musk's plans to shake up mobile industry with Starlink should be laughed out of the room
Article Text:
What T-Mobile CEO Peter Osvaldik said first

AT&T CEO John Stankey's rebuttal: Fiber beats satellite, full stop

Why the rivalry is heating up

The scale of Starlink's ambitions

Why Stankey says the math doesn't work

AT&T CEO John Stankey has sided with T-Mobile’s chief executive Peter Osvaldik in rejecting Elon Musk ’s plan to disrupt the mobile industry with Starlink. Speaking to Axios, Stankey said SpaceX ’s proposal to turn its satellite business into a global competitor to traditional telecom networks is “not a viable strategy.” He argued that fiber infrastructure remains superior, noting AT&T’s $3 billion deal with Corning to expand its fiber footprint. Earlier this month, T-Mobile CEO Peter Osvaldik dismissed Musk’s Starlink ambitions outright, and said that the strategy should be “laughed out of the room. ” Osvaldik said Starlink’s approach lacked the scale and economics to compete with established carriers, reinforcing skepticism across the telecom industry.T-Mobile CFO Peter Osvaldik was blunt in his own assessment of Starlink's mobile ambitions, saying that "everybody in the know" is laughing at parts of the plan, and describing SpaceX's proposal as something that isn't fathomable from a technical standpoint. He argued Starlink doesn't represent a real competitive threat from a wireless perspective, pointing to basic physics as the core obstacle: satellite signals, he said, can't penetrate buildings, walls, or even something as simple as a car windshield, making Starlink's direct-to-cell ambitions far less practical in dense urban environments than in the remote areas where satellite coverage genuinely shines.Speaking to Axios, Stankey made a similarly confident case for why AT&T isn't worried, backing it with a major infrastructure move. AT&T announced a $3 billion deal with Corning this week to expand its fiber infrastructure, arguing that fiber delivers speeds three times faster than satellite technology. Stankey didn't mince words about the comparison, saying nothing beats fiber, and that even if satellite technology performs at its absolute best over the next decade, it still won't be able to match what fiber delivers.The pushback from both carriers comes as Musk and SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell have been increasingly vocal about turning Starlink into a genuine competitor to traditional phone and internet providers. Starlink already competes with legacy telecom companies for home and business internet customers, and the company has now started talking openly about a mobile business that would put it in direct competition with wireless carriers.Shotwell added fuel to that narrative in August, during SpaceX's first earnings call as a public company, predicting that SpaceX would be able to win over a meaningful number of customers from existing carriers because its service would simply be better. That comment rattled markets, sending shares of AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile lower the following day.As of June 30, Starlink had 12 million subscribers and more than 10,200 satellites providing coverage across 167 countries, according to SpaceX's first earnings report as a public company. While SpaceX's rockets and AI work tend to dominate headlines, its connectivity business is actually the company's largest revenue driver, accounting for 55% of total sales.Becoming a genuine fourth major US mobile carrier, however, would require significantly more terrestrial infrastructure to match the capacity of a traditional cellular network — a build-out one analyst estimated could cost SpaceX more than $100 billion. SpaceX believes it has found a cheaper alternative: installing small cellular base stations alongside Starlink dishes at homes and businesses, adding capacity where satellite coverage alone falls short, without needing to build the kind of sprawling cell tower network traditional carriers rely on. Musk has claimed these small stations could eventually deliver connectivity to phones with better and higher bandwidth than what's currently available from existing cellular providers.Stankey pushed back hard on that plan's feasibility, arguing that installing enough small stations to match a traditional network's capacity would cost roughly the same as simply building a full macro cellular network. He also pointed to a significant regulatory hurdle: current law doesn't allow companies to radiate cellular signals from someone's home without their permission, unless that law changes. He suggested that if the approach were genuinely viable and cost-effective, AT&T would already be installing similar antennas across its own massive existing fiber network.
Article Summary: At&t ceo john stankey says spacex's starlink plan is "not a viable strategy" he argued that fiber infrastructure remains superior, noting at&t’s $3 billion deal with corning to expand its fiber footprint. Earlier this month, t-mobile ceo peter osvaldik said starlink's approach lacked the scale and economics to compete with established carriers.

Article Title: Pebble launches Qore Ultra wellness band at introductory price of Rs 5,999
Article Text:
Pebble Qore Ultra

Pebble Qore Ultra features

Pebble Qore Ultra price and availability

Home-grown consumer electronics brand Pebble has launched Qore Ultra, its flagship wellness band. In a press release, the company said that the device is designed for continuous, distraction-free wear. Coming with 3 ATM water-resistant design, Qore Ultra integrates a 4-PD precision sensor array and 6-axis motion sensors. “This hardware architecture enables 24x7 tracking of vital metrics, including heart rate, HRV, SpO2, respiration, and stress, while delivering up to 15 days of continuous battery life,” it stated.The band features automatic workout detection for activities like walking and running, over 100 sports modes, and in-app GPS sports tracking. The Pebble Qore mobile application acts as the central hub for this health intelligence, seamlessly translating complex data into intuitive metrics. Users can gauge their daily preparedness through a 0-100 Readiness Score, factoring in HRV, sleep quality, and stress, while monitoring their real-time stamina via the Body Energy Score. For long-term health tracking, the platform calculates Body Age every three days and uses GPS-tracked runs to estimate VO2 Max and Fitness Age.Komal Agarwal, Co-founder of Pebble said “The Pebble Qore series has become one of India's top fitness bands, and the Qore Ultra represents the flagship evolution of that journey. We have put a significant amount of R&D into giving users actionable data that can help them improve their daily rest, activity, and habits. By providing these comprehensive insights alongside community features on our new app, we are shifting the focus from isolated tracking to shared wellness management. ”Pebble Qore Ultra will be available from October 2, 2026 in three color options, Desert Gold, Deep Black, and Deep Blue. Priced at an introductory Rs 5,999 (MRP 8,999), the wearable will be available through Pebble's official website, Flipkart, Amazon, and leading retail stores across the country.

Article Title: Gold gets its festive shine back as lower prices lure Asian buyers
Article Text:
Gold prices hold firm ahead of festive season

Lower gold prices are beginning to bring physical buyers back into key Asian markets, with demand improving in India and signs of increased buying interest in Singapore. However, some buyers continue to wait for prices to fall further before stepping into the market.Gold prices in the country drop to Rs 145,538 per 10 grams this week, the lowest level in nearly two months. The correction brought more buyers into the market compared with the previous week and also resulted in sellers offering smaller discounts.Harshad Ajmera of Kolkata-based wholesaler JJ Gold House said demand had improved as the price decline made buyers more interested.“Demand was better than last week as prices corrected, making buyers more interested and narrowing the discounts offered by sellers,” he told Reuters.Discounts in India narrowed sharply during the week. Dealers offered discounts of as much as $14 an ounce over official domestic prices, including 15% import and 3% sales levies. This was significantly lower than the discounts of up to $43 an ounce offered the previous week.Buying interest could strengthen further if prices remain around current levels, particularly with the festival season approaching. A Mumbai-based dealer with a private bank said jewellers and investors were showing greater interest.“Gold could start trading at a premium next week if prices stay around current levels. Jewelers and investors are now showing more interest in buying as festival season is approaching,” said the dealer.India will celebrate Dussehra this month, followed by Diwali in early November. Buying gold is considered auspicious during the festive period.China, the biggest consumer market, also saw physical gold trade above the global benchmark, with bullion fetching premiums of $5 to $10 an ounce. However, buyers there remained closely focused on price movements.Bernard Sin, regional director, Greater China at MKS PAMP, said periods of price consolidation or declines were prompting greater buying activity, while another fall in international prices could further support physical demand."Demand remains highly price-sensitive, with buyers being more active during periods of price consolidation or pullbacks. A further decline in spot gold prices could therefore provide additional support to physical volumes," said Sin.The physical market activity comes as international spot gold prices headed for a weekly decline on Friday. Prices had already fallen by more than 6% in September.Elsewhere, gold in Singapore changed hands within a relatively narrow range, from a $1.5 an ounce discount to a $1 premium. Hong Kong saw prices move between a $1.5 discount and a $0.5 premium.Singapore also recorded signs of stronger physical buying, based on dealer inventories."We are noticing an uptick in physical demand in Singapore, based on dealers' inventory," Hugo Pascal, a precious metals trader at InProved told Reuters.Japan's physical gold market remained within a similarly narrow range, with the metal sold at discounts of up to $0.25 an ounce or premiums of as much as $0.5.
